given.note: B5-34's 'Yes: a signed contract first': at Lee Home Services, jobs over the plug-in's amount need a written estimate, and the $640 water heater replacement is over it (the $179 drain needs none). On Alex's secure page, before any money step, in one commit: Rosie builds the contract from the price and the parts the plug-in and the owner require (K-35 documents, origin built, kind contract, of this booking), its English words from a checked text with their sha256 (K-35 document_texts), and one signer, Alex (K-35 document_signers, signs_as Customer). The plug-in names no other signer for this work, so no co-signer's link is made; with one, each would get their own secure link for Alex to forward, never texted (MC C9). 'The business sending it is its signature.' No key; the money step waits until everyone has signed (README default 97). The document and signer ids are examples (README default 48).
